## Script: `/usr/local/bin/atomic-deploy.sh`

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# atomic-deploy.sh - Atomic release swap with health check and rollback
#
# Usage: ./atomic-deploy.sh <release-path>
# Example: ./atomic-deploy.sh /srv/myapp/releases/20240115-123456
#

set -euo pipefail

# =============================================================================
# Configuration
# =============================================================================
readonly RELEASE_DIR="/srv/myapp/releases"
readonly CURRENT_LINK="/srv/myapp/current"
readonly HEALTH_URL="http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz"
readonly DEPLOY_LOG="/srv/myapp/deploy.log"
readonly HEALTH_CHECK_RETRIES=5
readonly HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL=2
readonly HEALTH_CHECK_WAIT=3

# =============================================================================
# State tracking (for trap cleanup)
# =============================================================================
RELEASE_PATH=""
PREVIOUS_RELEASE=""
ROLLBACK_NEEDED=false

# =============================================================================
# Logging functions
# =============================================================================
log() {
    local level="$1"
    shift
    local msg="$*"
    local timestamp
    timestamp=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    echo "[${timestamp}] [${level}] ${msg}" | tee -a "${DEPLOY_LOG}"
}

log_info()  { log "INFO" "$@"; }
log_warn()  { log "WARN" "$@"; }
log_error() { log "ERROR" "$@"; }

# =============================================================================
# Cleanup / Rollback handler
# =============================================================================
cleanup() {
    local exit_code=$?
    
    if [[ "${ROLLBACK_NEEDED}" == "true" && -n "${PREVIOUS_RELEASE}" ]]; then
        log_warn "ROLLBACK: Restoring symlink to ${PREVIOUS_RELEASE}"
        
        if ! ln -sfn "${PREVIOUS_RELEASE}" "${CURRENT_LINK}"; then
            log_error "ROLLBACK FAILED: Could not restore symlink"
            exit 1
        fi
        
        log_info "ROLLBACK: Symlink restored to ${PREVIOUS_RELEASE}"
        log_warn "ROLLBACK: Previous release ${RELEASE_PATH} preserved for investigation"
    fi
    
    exit "${exit_code}"
}

trap cleanup EXIT

# =============================================================================
# Validation functions
# =============================================================================
validate_release_path() {
    local path="$1"
    
    if [[ -z "${path}" ]]; then
        log_error "Usage: $0 <release-path>"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    if [[ ! -d "${path}" ]]; then
        log_error "Release directory does not exist: ${path}"
        exit 1
    fi
    
    if [[ ! -d "${path}/bin" && ! -d "${path}/app" ]]; then
        log_warn "Release may be incomplete (no bin/ or app/ directory)"
    fi
    
    log_info "Release path validated: ${path}"
}
